mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, post_id AS postId FROM sys_user_post

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.status AS status FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_post up ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.post_id = #{postId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' ORDER BY u.user_id
